It hangs from a short closed loop of thick brass chain with big oval links, which is part of it; the loop is no taller than the pendant itself and joins a sturdy ring at the pendant's top.
colours: Bright yellow brass with brown shading; the eye blue, white and black.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the pendant below, the whole thing inside the picture.
must_show: one flat brass hand-shaped plaque, fingers down

what: a small charm cast in dark bronze in the shape of a horse standing still, seen from the side, facing left: stiff and simple like an ancient Celtic votive figure, with an arched neck, a long head, four straight legs and a long tail; one solid piece of metal, with no rider and no saddle. A round metal ring is fixed on the middle of its back, and a short closed loop of dark brown leather cord, no taller than the horse, passes through the ring.
colours: Dark brown bronze with warm yellow-brown highlights on the neck, back and rump; dark brown cord.
pose: Seen from the side, the horse level and upright, hanging from the loop of cord above its back, the whole thing inside the picture.
must_show: one small bronze horse, side view

what: an amulet: one great round gem like a ball, deep dark blood-red, nearly black at its edges, with a bright red glow at its centre; it is gripped from above by four curved claws of black iron that reach halfway down it. It hangs from a short closed loop of thick black iron chain with big oval links, which is part of it; the loop is no taller than the pendant itself and joins a sturdy ring at the pendant's top.
colours: Dark blood-red gem with a bright red core and black edges; black iron claws and chain with pale grey lit edges.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the pendant below, the whole thing inside the picture.
must_show: black iron claws gripping it from above

what: a pendant carved from one piece of pale apple-green jade in the shape of a small round apple, glossy, with a white glint, a short stalk at the top and one small carved jade leaf beside the stalk. A cap of bright silver round the stalk carries a ring. It hangs from a short closed loop of thick silver chain with big oval links, which is part of it; the loop is no taller than the pendant itself and joins a sturdy ring at the pendant's top.
colours: Pale milky apple-green jade, deeper green in the shadow; bright silver cap and chain.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the pendant below, the whole thing inside the picture.

what: an amulet carved from one piece of pale grey-green jade in the shape of a cicada seen from above, head at the top: a broad blunt head with two round bulging eyes at its corners, and behind it two long smooth wings folded shut side by side down its back, coming to a blunt point at the bottom, with one straight groove between them. It is simple, smooth and stylised, as carved in ancient China. A black silk cord threaded through the head rises in a short closed loop no taller than the cicada.
colours: Pale milky grey-green jade, darker grey-green in the grooves, a white glint; black cord.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the pendant below, the whole thing inside the picture.
must_show: one pale jade insect seen from above
two bulging eyes at the top
folded wings with a groove between

what: a golden ornament made of a breastplate and two earrings joined together: in the middle one small flat shield-shaped chest plate of bright yellow gold, with a rounded top, bearing in bold relief one round sun with short rays; and hanging from its lower edge, one at the left and one at the right, two large round gold hoop earrings, each a third as wide as the plate, linked to it. A ring on top of the plate joins the chain. It hangs from a short closed loop of thick gold chain with big oval links, which is part of it; the loop is no taller than the pendant itself and joins a sturdy ring at the pendant's top.
colours: Bright yellow gold all over, brown-gold in the shadows, white glints.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the pendant below, the whole thing inside the picture.
must_show: one small gold plate with a sun on it
two gold hoops hanging from it

what: a charm in the shape of an ancient Greek lyre, as wide as it is tall: at the bottom a round bowl made of a dark tortoise shell; from the left and right edges of the shell two thick arms of yellow gold rise far apart and curve like a bull's two horns, their tips well apart at the top; one straight gold crossbar joins the two arms near their tips; and four thick gold strings run straight down side by side from the crossbar to the shell, with open space showing between the arms and the strings. A ring on the middle of the crossbar joins the chain. It hangs from a short closed loop of thick gold chain with big oval links, which is part of it; the loop is no taller than the charm itself.
colours: Dark brown mottled tortoise shell; bright yellow gold arms, crossbar and strings.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the pendant below, the whole thing inside the picture.
must_show: one small lyre: round shell at the bottom, two horn-shaped arms far apart, a crossbar

what: a talisman: one jagged shard of black volcanic glass, a long flake with broken slanting faces and razor edges, pointed at the bottom, glossy coal-black with sharp bright white glints along its edges. Its blunt top is wrapped in a binding of bright gold wire with a ring. It hangs from a short closed loop of thick dark brown leather cord, which is part of it; the loop is no taller than the pendant itself and is knotted at the pendant's top.
colours: Glossy coal-black with white glints on the edges and dark grey faces; bright yellow gold wire; dark brown cord.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the pendant below, the whole thing inside the picture.
must_show: one jagged glossy black shard, point down
gold wire binding at the top

what: a pendant of bright silver in the shape of a snake bent into a perfect circle and swallowing the tip of its own tail: one thick ring with a clear round hole through the middle, covered in bold scales. It hangs from a short closed loop of thick silver chain with big oval links, which is part of it; the loop is no taller than the pendant itself and joins a sturdy ring at the pendant's top.
colours: Bright silver with dark grey between the scales; one small emerald-green eye.
pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the pendant below, the whole thing inside the picture.

what: a charm of bright yellow gold in the shape of a herald's wand: one straight upright rod with a small round knob on top; just below the knob a pair of short spread wings of white silver, one on each side; and below the wings two golden snakes winding round the rod and crossing it three times, their two heads facing each other under the wings. pose: Seen from the front, hanging straight down from its short loop, the loop above and the pendant below, the whole thing inside the picture.

a pair of small white wings near the top

what: a belt that is one long cord braided from spider silk, with nobody wearing it: a thick three-strand plait of shining silver-white silk, as thick as a thumb, knotted at the front, with two short ends hanging a little way below the knot. Fixed on the knot is one clasp of yellow gold in the shape of a spider with its eight legs spread, as big as a walnut.
colours: Shining silver-white silk with pale grey in the grooves of the plait; one yellow gold spider.
pose: Seen from the front and a little from above, hanging in the air as one closed loop, as if buckled round an invisible waist, the fastening at the front in the middle; the inside of the loop is empty.
must_show: one closed loop of white braided cord
knot at the front with short ends
one gold spider on the knot

what: a ball of thread on a belt-hook: one round ball as big as a fist, wound from thick shining silver thread in bold criss-crossing bands, hanging directly beneath and touching a sturdy belt-hook of dark iron: a short flat upright plate whose top curls over into a hook. colours: Bright silver-white thread, grey between the windings; the hook dark iron with pale grey lit edges.
pose: Seen from the front, the hook at the top and the ball hanging directly below it, touching, the whole thing inside the picture.

dark iron hook joined above it

what: a child's stuffed toy, hand-sewn from soft orange cloth: a small plump lizard-dragon sitting upright on its hind legs, with a round head, two short arms, two stubby feet, a pale cream belly panel, two black button eyes, a stitched smile, seams of visible stitching, and a thick tail curling up beside it whose tip is a flame cut from red and yellow felt. colours: Soft orange cloth, pale cream belly, black button eyes; the tail-tip flame red and yellow felt.
pose: Sitting upright, seen from the front and a little to one side, the tail curling up at the right.
must_show: one soft stuffed toy lizard-dragon, sitting
felt flame on the tail tip

what: a young artist's sketchbook, closed: a thick book bound in faded lavender cloth, with worn frayed corners and a darker spine, the edges of its cream paper pages showing uneven and dog-eared, held shut by a ribbon of pale gold tied round it in a bow. On the front cover is one bold five-pointed star drawn in silver.
colours: Faded soft lavender cloth, darker lavender-grey spine, cream page edges, pale gold ribbon, a silver star.
pose: Closed, front cover to the viewer, tilted a little so the spine and the page edges show.
must_show: lavender cover with a silver star
